IVX FINAL CLOSEOUT — ITEM 1 OF 7
CI QA SUITE ONLY

MISSION

Fix and fully verify the current failing IVX CI QA Suite.

WORK ONLY ON THIS ITEM.

Do not work on:
- autonomous E2E certification
- soak test
- Android build
- new features
- UI improvements
- new dashboards
- architecture changes
- unrelated cleanup

Do not move to Item 2.

==================================================
1. READ CURRENT STATE
==================================================

Inspect the CURRENT GitHub repository and CURRENT CI state.

Identify:

REPOSITORY:
BRANCH:
GITHUB HEAD SHA:
CI WORKFLOW:
CI RUN ID:
FAILED JOB:
FAILED STEP:
FAILED TESTS:
EXACT ERROR:

Do not use an old Rork report as proof.

==================================================
2. CREDENTIAL RULE
==================================================

Assume required credentials already exist in IVX runtime/CI variables.

Do NOT ask the owner for credentials unless actual execution proves:

- variable missing
- variable deleted
- variable expired
- variable revoked
- incorrect environment binding
- HTTP 401
- HTTP 403

If authentication fails, return:

SERVICE:
ENVIRONMENT:
EXPECTED VARIABLE NAME:
VARIABLE EXISTS: YES/NO
LOADED AT RUNTIME: YES/NO
HTTP STATUS:
EXACT ERROR:
TRACE/RUN ID:

Never expose secret values.

==================================================
3. FIND ROOT CAUSE
==================================================

Open the actual failing CI logs.

Determine the real root cause.

Classify it as applicable:

- application defect
- test defect
- CI configuration
- dependency
- environment
- timeout
- browser/Playwright
- database
- authentication
- networking
- race condition
- stale test expectation
- other

Return the exact evidence.

Do not guess.

==================================================
4. FIX THE ROOT CAUSE
==================================================

Make the minimum correct source/configuration/test changes.

Do NOT:

- delete legitimate tests
- skip failing tests
- disable CI gates
- convert failures into warnings
- use || true
- hide exit codes
- reduce acceptance criteria just to get PASS

A green CI run obtained by bypassing QA is a FAILURE.

==================================================
5. LOCAL/ISOLATED VALIDATION
==================================================

Before pushing, run the applicable failing tests.

Then run the relevant regression suite.

Record:

COMMAND:
PASSED:
FAILED:
SKIPPED:
DURATION:

If something cannot execute, mark:

NOT EXECUTED

Do not simulate results.

==================================================
6. GITHUB WRITE
==================================================

If a real change was required:

commit
→ push directly to owner-controlled GitHub
→ verify remote commit exists

Return:

FILES CHANGED:
COMMIT SHA:
REMOTE SHA:
BRANCH:

COMMIT SHA must be obtained from Git.

Do not invent identifiers.

==================================================
7. RUN REAL CI
==================================================

Trigger or allow the real GitHub CI workflow to run against that commit.

Wait for the actual result available in this execution session.

Return:

WORKFLOW:
RUN ID:
COMMIT SHA:
STARTED:
FINISHED:
JOBS:
PASSED:
FAILED:
SKIPPED:
FINAL CONCLUSION:

==================================================
8. ACCEPTANCE GATE
==================================================

ITEM 1 passes ONLY when:

[ ] Actual failing CI run inspected
[ ] Exact root cause identified
[ ] Root cause corrected
[ ] Relevant tests pass
[ ] Regression tests pass
[ ] Change committed if required
[ ] Change exists on owner GitHub
[ ] Real GitHub CI executed
[ ] CI QA Suite final result = PASS

A local PASS is not enough.

A commit is not enough.

A push is not enough.

A Render deployment is not relevant to this item.

==================================================
9. STOP AFTER ITEM 1
==================================================

When Item 1 is complete, STOP.

DO NOT automatically start Item 2.

Return exactly:

IVX CLOSEOUT — ITEM 1/7

STATUS:
PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT VERIFIED

ROOT CAUSE:

FILES CHANGED:

TEST EVIDENCE:

GITHUB COMMIT:

CI WORKFLOW:

CI RUN ID:

CI FINAL RESULT:

CURRENT GITHUB HEAD:

BLOCKER:
NONE or exact blocker

ITEM 1 CERTIFICATION:
VERIFIED / NOT VERIFIED

NEXT:
WAITING FOR OWNER TO AUTHORIZE ITEM 2

IMPORTANT:

No narrative-only PASS.
No fake execution.
No reused evidence.
No simulated GitHub results.
No planned work reported as completed.
Do not claim VERIFIED until the real CI QA Suite is green.

BEGIN ITEM 1 NOW.
